logical_storage.charge: Monotone conservative encoded logical upper: all TEXT wires plus canonical metadata and declared index keys; repeated copies charged. Replace observation integer counters with19-digit upper-envelope and accounting counts with selected caps. Separately charge staged operation INSERT before its deferred UPDATE. This credit unit bounds encoded accepted row images; it is not exact resident allocation, physical tuple/page/WAL or actual index entry count.

No auxiliary staging/guard rows or DELETE. Final-key logical counts and row-DML touch counters are distinct.
